sources.title: Aegis — Pre-Deployment Security Scanner for AI Systems
sources.snippet: Aegis — Pre-Deployment Security Scanner for AI Systems Catch what generic scanners miss. Aegis is purpose-built for the threat surface of AI-driven codebases — hallucinated dependencies, prompt injection boundaries, PII flowing raw into model APIs, and agentic loop topologies — all in a single scan, zero config required.

sources.title: Aegis AI Security Scanner
sources.snippet: AI-powered security vulnerability scanner. Analyze source code, web applications, and networks for security risks with automated remediation powered by Claude AI.

sources.title: Aegis — Adversarial security testing for AI models and agents
sources.snippet: Aegis stress-tests your AI models and agents the way attackers will: multi-turn conversations, tool-call abuse, prompt injection. Outputs an audit-ready report your legal team can actually use.

sources.title: Aegis AI Security Scanner - Visual Studio Marketplace
sources.snippet: Where The Fix Features Are Place the cursor on an Aegis diagnostic line, then use Ctrl+. or the lightbulb. Aegis: 应用 AI 精准修复: replaces the vulnerable code when AI confidence is high. Aegis: 应用示例修复代码: replaces the vulnerable code with a framework-aware safe example. Aegis: 插入 AI 修复建议: inserts comments only.
